headline: MIL @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.68 at CIN 4.04, with a projected total of 8.72. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: MIL moved -0.03 runs while CIN moved -0.30, changing the projected margin by +0.28 runs. The projected total fell -0.33, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +8.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shane Drohan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Brice Turang, William Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Eugenio Suárez, Spencer Steer because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
